EvidenceRef-Output.description: Pointer to the timestamped transcript excerpt a task comes from.

audio_available.title: Audio Available
audio_available.description: Audio files still on disk (see retention).

key.title: Key
key.description: YYYY-MM for a month, YYYY for a year.

goal_days.title: Goal Days
goal_days.description: Days in the period where the daily goal was reached.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: A team member tasks can be assigned to (the lead's team directory).

team.title: Team
team.description: Team completions in the month (no points, no ranking).

TaskCreate.title: TaskCreate
TaskCreate.description: Manual creation from the desktop app (ui scope).

index.title: Index
index.description: Target index inside the destination column.

retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: Days to keep the audio after a successful transcription (0 = delete).

UserProfile.description: The user's profile (profile.yaml): used to flag the tasks that concern them.
